scripts.dev:backend-worker: env UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run --directory backend python -m app.tasks.worker
scripts.test:backend: env UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run --directory backend pytest --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered
scripts.lint:backend: env UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run --directory backend ruff check .
scripts.format:backend: env UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run --directory backend ruff format .
scripts.docker:migrate: docker compose exec backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.docker:migrate:current: docker compose exec backend alembic current
